_comment: TRUSTED CHECK MANIFEST — the acceptance criteria for a packaged-validation run.
This file exists because ci_assert_service_results.py used to read expected_total,
groups[].expected and every check name FROM THE FILE IT WAS VALIDATING. It therefore
proved only that a results document was internally self-consistent, and a twelve-line
forgery declaring zero checks produced
'SERVICE SCOPE COMPLETED: 0/0 checks passed in full:service' with exit 0 (VAL-01).
A result may REPORT what it observed. It may not DEFINE what is acceptable. That is
what lives here: committed, reviewed, and outside the artifact under test.
Counts are the arithmetic of scripts/tracking_validate_macos.sh's own group table
(group_size + scope_groups). scripts/validation_manifest_check.sh re-derives them from
that script and fails if the two disagree, so this file cannot drift away from the
harness it describes — and the harness's enumerate_checks() independently proves the
group table against the actual call sites before any check runs. Three independent
statements of the same number; a single edit cannot move all three quietly.

full:service.description: The packaged macOS service lifecycle: installs, exercises and removes a namespaced LaunchAgent.

_comment: The SERVICE group is the reason the packaged job exists, so its nine checks are
named here individually rather than only counted. Labels interpolate runtime
values (a resolved path, a pid, a uid), so each entry is the STATIC prefix of the
label; the validator requires a one-to-one match between these and the SERVICE
rows in the register. A check that is renamed, dropped, duplicated, or replaced
by an unrelated one fails here even when the count still adds up.
SERVICE: the apply installed a real LaunchAgent the product can name
the installed LaunchAgent declares the label the product reports
the label is namespaced per data directory, not the global one
the LaunchAgent runs the helper the product installed in this run's data directory
the installed helper is byte-identical to the in-bundle helper
launchd loaded the namespaced service gui/
the service exposes its control endpoint at $TETHRA_DIR/gateway.sock, mode 0600

full:foreground.description: The unsigned-build fallback: a foreground gateway, no LaunchAgent. NOT a substitute for full:service.

offline:none.description: No gateway is started and no network request is made.

selfcheck:none.description: Proves only that the harness reports a deliberately-broken control as a failure.
